speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Clostridioides difficile infection.

The clinical picture of severe watery diarrhea (9+ episodes) in a patient recently treated with levofloxacin is highly suggestive of antibiotic-associated colitis. While your script mentions "no recent antibiotics," the specific use of levofloxacin is a major risk factor. The presence of abdominal cramping and the absence of blood or fever further support this diagnosis over a urinary tract infection. I am awaiting the results of the C. Diff Toxigenic Assay to confirm.
